description: Source code for a utility class 'CustomFunction_Utilities' that implements an 'INode' interface, enabling execution of custom JavaScript functions with support for input variables, tools, and sandboxed code execution.

classes.name: CustomFunction_Utilities
classes.description: A class implementing INode to execute custom JavaScript functions with configurable inputs, outputs, and sandboxed execution environment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes and executes the custom JavaScript function within a sandbox, processing input variables and tools.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs the 'init' method with 'isRun' flag set to true, for executing the function.
